knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "YOU HAVE A CHOICE WHEN IT COMES TO PHYSICAL THERAPY Northwoods Therapy is located in four locations for your rehabilitation needs to get you back to your normal activities; Altoona, WI, Chippewa Falls, WI, Lake Hallie, WI in the Valley Sports Academy and Menomonie, WI in the Oakleaf Clinic building. At Northwoods Therapy Associates we recognize the basic dignity and rights of all patients, employees, students, referral sources and community members. We promise to be responsive to the immediate pain and emergency needs of every one of our patients, are taking physical therapy to the next level by providing health, wellness and performance instruction for you and your family and want you to come see how we can keep you in the game of life!"
